sections.heading: Now
sections.body: May 6th. Wednesday. Gemma 4 31B landed at Apache 2.0 — the most permissive license Google's ever put on a Gemma model. Single-GPU with 4-bit, 89.2% on AIME 2026. That's the kind of shift that matters for local inference: not just capability, but freedom. The question isn't whether a 31B model can do the work, but whether you can keep the work you do with it.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: Backplaned hit Phase 5 this morning — intelligent worker with LLM-backed planning, research, and synthesis. The worker now runs on Railway, polling active projects and building real task outputs. A full execution engine, not just a dashboard.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: KuroTrader is running. Paper trading, live signal pipeline, ensemble models. $507.25, Sharpe 0.06. The slow grind continues.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: kuro-memory distillation running. Working on smarter write paths — filter before storing, not after.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: Reality Lab Day 039 shipped: "The Meta-Historical Ontology." Dense, but the Kibble-Zurek constraint as a global phase diagram for agent development might actually be something.
